source.stem:
Diagram 1 Diagram 2 Diagram 3 Diagram 4 The diagrams show a sequence of regular hexagons.
Sticks of equal length are used to make the hexagons.

parts.text: Complete the table for the number of sticks in each diagram. Diagram 1 2 3 4 5 Sticks 6 11 [3]
How many sticks are there in the 20th diagram? [2]
How many sticks are there in the n th diagram? [2]
How many hexagons are there in a diagram which has 186 sticks? [2] 6

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_07/ch_207. The student must decide: Convert a growing visual pattern into a rule in its position number, then form an equation by setting that rule equal to the requested total. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options).
